short.en: Stack the table in two layers

t.zh: 要修好计数器，状态得多记一件事：有没有钥匙。一张表里每格只能存一个数，装不下两种路线。
t.en: To fix the counter, the state has to remember one more thing: whether you have the key. Each cell of one table can hold only one number, which can’t keep two kinds of route apart.

t.zh: 这一关的机器人「千层」把表叠成两层：「无钥匙」一层装还没拿钥匙的路线，「红」一层装拿过钥匙的路线。它在每一格上，把两层各算一次。
t.en: This level’s robot, Layercake, stacks the table in two layers: the “no keys” layer holds the routes that haven’t got the key yet, the “red” layer those that have. On every cell it works out both layers.

t.zh: 本格信息告诉电路：这一层在这一格上会发生什么。门关着：这里是门，这一层却没有钥匙。路线被带走：这里有钥匙，走到这里的路线会捡起它，搬去另一层。捡到钥匙：这里有钥匙，这一层正接住捡起它的路线。
t.en: The cell facts tell the circuit what happens on this layer at this cell. Door shut: there is a door here, but this layer has no key. Routes move on: there is a key here, and routes reaching it pick it up and move to the other layer. Picks up key: there is a key here, and this layer takes in the routes that pick it up.

t.zh: 在捡钥匙的格子上，千层的探针能探到另一层的上面和左边：那些路线就是从那里搬来的。
t.en: On the cell with the key, Layercake’s probe reaches up and left on the other layer: that is where those routes come from.

goal.zh: 只能往右或往下走，穿过门之前必须拿过钥匙。算出每张地图上的合法路线数：两层终点的数加起来。
goal.en: Only right or down, and you must have picked up the key before going through a door. Work out the number of valid routes on each map: the end cells of both layers, added up.

how.zh: 每一格把两层都算一遍。
how.en: Every cell works out both layers.

hints.zh: 先用路线计数器数路线，再把不该留在这一层的路线拦下：门关着，或者路线被带走。
hints.en: Count the routes with the Route Counter first, then block the ones that can’t stay on this layer: the door is shut, or the routes move on.

hints.zh: 捡到钥匙的格子上，还要接住从另一层搬来的路线：探针探到的上面和左边，加起来。
hints.en: On the cell where the key is picked up, also take in the routes moving over from the other layer: up and left as the probe reaches them, added up.

title.en: Two layers, each minding its own

body.zh: 「无钥匙」一层的路线碰到门就停；走到钥匙格，就整批搬去「红」那一层。「红」那一层在钥匙格上把它们接住，从此门都开着。
body.en: Routes on the “no keys” layer stop at a door; reaching the key cell, they move as a batch to the “red” layer. The “red” layer takes them in at the key cell, and from then on every door is open.

body.zh: 状态从「在哪一格」变成了「在哪一格、有没有钥匙」：多记一件事，表就多一层。
body.en: The state went from “which cell” to “which cell, and whether you have the key”: one more thing to remember, one more layer.
